parameters.jsCode: const results=$input.all().map(i=>i.json);const selected=$('Select official emails').all().map(i=>i.json.email.id);const mode=$('Select official emails').first().json.run_mode;const profile=$('Runner configuration').first().json.config;if(results.some(r=>r.status==='persisted'&&(r.workflow_version!=='v2.1-currency-1'||r.observability?.profile_revision!==profile.profile_revision||r.observability?.model!==profile.model)))throw new Error('Processor result profile/model mismatch; do not accept as baseline evidence.');if(mode==='baseline'&&(results.length!==12||results.some(r=>r.status!=='persisted')||new Set(results.map(r=>r.email_id)).size!==12||results.some(r=>!selected.includes(r.email_id))))throw new Error('Fresh V2.1 baseline must have 12 newly persisted results.');return [{json:{version:'v2.1-currency-1',run_mode:mode,run_id:mode==='baseline'?'v2.1-currency-baseline':'v2.1-currency-smoke',runner_execution_id:String($execution.id),model:profile.model,baseline_model:profile.baseline_model,v1_model_confirmed:profile.v1_model_confirmed,controlled_same_model_comparison:profile.controlled_same_model_comparison,results}}];
